metadata.title: The Streets--Tian conjecture on compact homogeneous quotients
metadata.abstract: A Hermitian-symplectic metric is a Hermitian metric whose Kähler form is given by the $(1,1)$-part of a closed $2$-form. Streets-Tian Conjecture states that a compact complex manifold admitting a Hermitian-symplectic metric must be Kählerian (i.e., admitting a Kähler metric). We study Hermitian-symplectic metrics on homogeneous complex manifolds with compact isotropy, and on their compact discrete quotients. If the transitive group is connected and unimodular, we show that an invariant Hermitian-symplectic form gives an invariant Kähler metric, with no lattice assumption. By averaging, the same conclusion holds for compact quotients, even if the initial metric has no invariant lift. The proof uses the top exterior power of a Hermitian-symplectic form to bound the volume functional on an invariant Aeppli slice. Applying this bound to midpoint metrics gives a uniform trace estimate. From this, volume maximization produces a balanced metric in the slice, which is also pluriclosed and hence Kähler. We also describe the resulting Kähler representative and give examples showing the role of the closed lift.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 对紧各向同性子群、连通幺模传递群下的齐性复流形，证明不变 Hermitian–辛形式产生不变 Kähler 度量，并通过平均推广到紧离散商。
analysis.breakthrough: 确认 Streets–Tian 猜想在这一齐性商范围内的结论，初始紧商度量无需不变提升。
analysis.limitations: 并未解决任意紧复流形的 Streets–Tian 猜想；幺模及闭二形式提升条件不可省。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者明确披露使用 ChatGPT 辅助论文发展，但没有说明具体用途，不推断核心想法、写作或证明的分工。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者明确披露使用 ChatGPT 辅助论文发展，但没有说明具体用途，不推断核心想法、写作或证明的分工。

analysis.priorityReason: 对非 Kähler 几何的重要猜想提供较广的对称情形。
